problem:
What is the area scale factor of the linear transformation $T$ that is given by its standard matrix 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}4 & 9 \\ 7 & 8\end{aligned}]?
$$

The area scale factor is
{{field-1}} .
worked_solution:
The area scale factor of a linear transformation $T$ with standard matrix $T$ is equal to $|det(T)|.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}|det(T)| & =|4\cdot 8-9\cdot 7| \\  & =|32-63| \\  & =|-31| \\  & =31.\end{aligned}
$$
